name: Rishi Laser Limited
about: Rishi Laser Limited manufactures and sells fabrication of sheet metal components and machines in India. The company provides parts for excavating machines; and manufactures steel fabrications and assemblies for a range of engineering industries. It also offers contract manufacturing, design and development, punching, sheet steel fabrication, bending, laser cutting, welding, and surface treatment services. The company serves textile and general engineering; telecommunications; chemical and food processing; aerospace and defense; electrical switchgear; power plant; railways; earthmoving equipment; and automotive industries. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Rishi Laser Cutting Limited and changed its name to Rishi Laser Limited in 2007. Rishi Laser Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
